result.reason: The redline appropriately assigns Deliverables to Customer, preserves Vendor Technology ownership, avoids joint ownership, and makes only targeted changes. However, it does not state that Customer retains all rights in Customer Data. It also relies on Section 13.2 for the embedded Vendor Technology licence without confirming that the licence is irrevocable and royalty-free, as required by the preferred position. The margin comment cannot cure these omissions from the operative language.
